title: Demographic and Socio-economic Profile of HDB Applicants in Last Two Years
what_it_is: Demographic and Socio-economic Profile of HDB Applicants in Last Two Years

sections.label: Rental flat applications and outcomes
sections.summary: About 7,300 households yearly requested rental flats; most had low income, and unsuccessful applicants may get interim or public rental if mediation fails.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In the last two years, an average of about 7,300 households requested for rental flats each year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Ninety percent had a household income of $1,500 or less.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Seventy percent applied alone or as a pair.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: About 40% were divorced or widowed, and a similar proportion were married.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Close to half of the households in public rental have owned an HDB flat before.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The most common reasons for unsuccessful applications include having sufficient budget to buy a flat, not meeting the citizenship requirement, or having family support for alternative accommodation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: If mediation is unsuccessful, and the applicants cannot afford to buy a flat, HDB will be prepared to offer an interim rental or a public rental flat.
